blocks.text: Haemoglobin RBCs mein maujood protein hai. Haemoglobin ka ek molecule chaar globin (gol, globular) polypeptide chains (do α aur do β) aur chaar haem groups se bana hai. α chain mein 141 aur β chain mein 146 amino acids hain. Har chain is tarah mudi hoti hai ke us mein ek jeb (pocket) banti hai jahan haem group judta hai; yun har chain ke saath ek haem hai. Haem group mein ek iron ion porphyrin ring ke beech pakda hota hai; iron ion porphyrin ring ke chaar nitrogen atoms se juda hota hai. Jab oxygen ka partial pressure zyada ho to iron ion ek O₂ molecule se jud jata hai. Is tarah haemoglobin ka ek molecule zyada se zyada chaar O₂ molecules le ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Chaaron chains kaise judi hain
blocks.text: Haemoglobin ki chaar polypeptide chains salt bridges, hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic effect (pani se door rehne wale hisson ka aapas mein judna) se ek doosre se bandhi hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke iron ion “polypeptide chain ke chaar nitrogen atoms” se juda hai. Asal mein yeh chaar nitrogen atoms haem ke porphyrin ring ke hain, polypeptide chain ke nahi.
